### Where is Spazedo?

### What facilities does Spazedo have?

### How much does a home interior cost?
Home interiors start from ₹1,450 per sq.ft. A 2 BHK on the DO PRO package is indicatively ₹8 to 10 lakh; the exact figure is confirmed after seeing your floor plan.

### What after service do you give?
A free service visit every 6 months for 5 years, plus a 10-year warranty.

### How do I book a site visit with Spazedo?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 63806 31302. Site visits and consultations are free across Chennai.
